title: Read and grow a vector safely
summary: Use optional indexed access, copy a scalar out of a borrowed entry, and preserve the vector for later mutation.

binding.clue: Modifier allowing the vector to grow and shrink

vectorType.clue: Growable owned sequence type containing unsigned 32-bit integers

construct.clue: Macro constructing a vector from the two listed values

checked.clue: Method providing optional indexed access instead of panicking out of bounds

missing.clue: Option method checking that index 9 is absent

copy.clue: Option adapter using Copy to turn Option<&u32> into Option<u32>

append.clue: Vector method appending a value at its end

equal.clue: Macro checking the independently retained first integer

length.clue: Method returning the number of current vector elements
